title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Different core arrangements in otherwise similarly ligated titanium-oxo cluster isomers can yield different photocatalytic hydrogen-evolution activities.
explanation: The vertical and horizontal PTC-49 Ti20 isomers have the same organic ligand types but different arrangements of titanium-oxo building units; the vertical isomer showed higher hydrogen production in the reported comparison.
scope: The PTC-49 vertical/horizontal titanium-oxo isomer pair.
caveats: This paired comparison supports a structural effect in that system, not a general ranking of all anatase-, rutile-, or brookite-like clusters.
